faq.description: Find answers to all your questions regarding real estate acquisition, sales, and investment processes here.

questions.question: Do you provide mortgage and financing assistance for home purchases?
questions.answer: Through our partnered private and public banks, we offer you the most favorable interest rates and flexible payment plans. You can also plan your budget in advance using our Investment & Loan Simulator.

questions.question: How does the rental guarantee system work for investment properties?
questions.answer: For select luxury projects in our portfolio, corporate rental and management guarantees are provided, ensuring regular monthly rental income during the contract period even if the property remains vacant.

questions.question: Is there support for citizenship and residency processes for foreign investors?
questions.answer: Yes, along with our expert legal team and real estate consultants, we manage your process of obtaining Turkish citizenship and residence permits through property investment from start to finish.

questions.question: Are the title deed status and appraisal of properties verified?
questions.answer: All properties added to our portfolio undergo title deed verification, zoning checks, encumbrance inspections, and independent appraisals to ensure they meet safe transaction standards.

questions.question: I want to sell or rent my property; how does the process work?
questions.answer: You can send us your request via our contact form or by reaching out to us directly. Our expert team inspects your property on-site, conducts a market analysis, and reaches the right buyers quickly through professional media shoots.
